summary: The HB06 post-expiry alignment corrupts GY01's first yellow reward model. When a yellow shiny reward is requested, retail pickup logic copies three position floats through the damaged matrix pointer into live HUD render state; the malformed pickup also produces severe geometry artifacts while play continues.

writes.member: current alpha and stored starting X/Y
BoneRemap, Mat, Scale, model/shadow IDs and animation-collision pointer

outcomes.description: While the reward remains active, its changing world X/Y/Z are written to the same indirect target every frame. Moving its spawn eight units on X changed the resulting float sequence; the destination address remained fixed.

Before the corrupted motive changes phase, the reward model's Mat pointer is 0x00D5CCC4. Retail reward placement writes three position floats at Mat+0x30, landing on HUD_TEXT_COMBOMESSAGE alpha and start_rc.loc.x/y.

The pickup renderer treats HUD memory as its transform while its scale and model metadata are also damaged, producing severe geometry artifacts. The 600-frame corrupt control remained live with no logged memory fault.
